Feeling worn out and in need of a treat after a tough week? A spa pedicure might be just what the doctor ordered. Phoenix, Arizona, is packed with nail salons that have all sorts of spa pedicure treats. A top spot to enjoy a fancy spa pedicure is Element Nails Bar. Here, you can kick back and relax, all while giving your feet some much needed love and care. What is a Spa Pedicure? A spa pedicure is a foot treatment that involves soaking, exfoliating, and moisturizing your feet. It also includes the grooming of the nails and cuticles.

A typical spa pedicure session usually lasts for about an hour, during which you can sit back, relax, and let the professionals take care of your feet. Why Choose Element Nails Bar? At Element Nails Bar, you'll experience a spa pedicure like no other. Their professional staff will welcome you with a warm smile and guide you through the process. You'll start with a warm foot soak infused with essential oils to help you relax and soothe your tired feet. Next, your feet will be exfoliated using a gentle scrub to remove dead skin cells and reveal soft, smooth skin. Afterward, your nails and cuticles will be expertly groomed and shaped
